data.name: Blossom
data.long_meaning: Blossom is derived from the Greek word 'anemone', meaning 'refresher' or 'renewer'. It symbolizes new beginnings, rebirth, and renewal. In Christian tradition, it represents the resurrection of Jesus and the spiritual rebirth of believers.
